topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, would you look at that! This mornin' I went to the well for a draw of water, and who should I see but the very same face I've been writin' to for near on a year now. It was none other than Johann, the miller's son, who's been grindin' the wheat for the village. We've been chattin' through them new-fangled letters on parchment that the scribe uses, you see. Turns out, he lives a stone’s throw away. Fancy that, all this time, and I never knew my problems with the soil were shared by a friend so close. I'll be sure to thank the saints for small miracles. Now, I reckon I'll be askin' Johann about his thoughts on the best ways to deal with the blight that's been troubling our crops.
